data_changes: None; preserve existing review IDs, labels, normalized duplicate policy and hotel-disjoint split.
routing_rules: Stateless clauses-v1 rules based on the user's supplied aspect vocabulary and diagnostic sentences. No fitted lexicon or test-driven routing thresholds.
selection: Validation polarity macro-F1; validation star accuracy; prefer full review on exact ties; classifier name.
calibration: Native uncalibrated probabilities for NB/LR. For SVC, sigmoid out-of-fold calibration in three stratified hotel-separated folds where feasible. Fit on training only for validation predictions, refit on development only for final predictions.
uncertainty: Validation correctness balanced accuracy selects a confidence threshold. Ties prefer coverage. No test thresholds.
test_metrics: Score all observed labels before mention or uncertainty abstention. Report coverage and selective accuracy separately.
additional_analysis: Within-one-star accuracy, all errors, per-class reports, coverage, mixed-aspect-label subset, and 500 hotel-cluster bootstrap replicates with paired old/new deltas.
known_limitation: Historical test results were already available. This is a controlled paired comparison on the established split, not an independent new confirmation dataset. No performance-driven tuning after observing new test metrics.
optional_models: Transformers and ordinal classifiers remain future work; no added dependencies or fabricated results.
